title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with two APPID/XDATA pairs

scope.source: Runtime-generated LTYPE and APPID records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

proof.source: Physical source fields and fresh import verify the exact ordered XDATA pairs and both APPID records. Import-time origin, raw/typed equality, ordered AppIdName references, and unique APPID-name joins bind both providers.
proof.output: The staged output proof checks the selected LTYPE's exact ordered 1001/1000 pairs, both APPID rows' common fields, flags and emitted table owner, then imports the output and checks typed XDATA values and unique APPID names.
proof.failure_retry: For each source/output encoding pair, removing the second APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late mutation of the second APPID name also refuses atomically and succeeds after correction on the same adapter.

limits: This qualifies one selected AC1027 simple-LTYPE profile with exactly two ordered 1001/1000 pairs and two distinct bare source-bound APPID providers. Zero, one, and two pairs are admitted by this selected path; other XDATA codes, three-or-more pairs, APPID metadata, other LTYPE schemas and versions remain unqualified.
The receipt establishes transport only. It does not qualify native XDATA application behavior, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
